# Trump approval rating still hovering near record lows, new poll shows

Portrait of Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Despite a slight improvement in the polls for President Donald Trump, his approval rating continues to hover near record lows in a new survey released by The Economist/YouGov on Aug. 25.

The poll found that 36% of Americans approved of Trump’s performance, a 1 percentage point improvement from last week’s The Economist/YouGov poll. [...] Despite the president’s improvement in The Economist/YouGov’s tracking in recent weeks, Trump is still hovering within 3 percentage points of his lowest approval rating since his return to the White House in 2025 (33%).
